yt_title: Jacob Misiorowski, the Brewers and MLB Awards Week 2026

slides.label: The title
slides.text: *Oct 28*: the Brewers beat the Rays in Game 5 for the *first World Series* in franchise history, capping a *103-59* season.

slides.label: The arm
slides.text: *Jacob Misiorowski*: *16-5*, a *1.80 ERA* and an MLB-best *252 strikeouts* in his second season.

slides.label: History
slides.text: Opponents hit *.157* against him, the *lowest average ever* allowed by a qualifying starter.

slides.label: The depth
slides.text: Pat Murphy, *Brice Turang* and *Trevor Megill* are on ballots too. *Four awards*, one team.

slides.label: New York
slides.text: The Yankees' *Cam Schlittler*: *1.95 ERA* and *239 strikeouts*, behind only Spud Chandler and Ron Guidry in team history.

question: Who was the best pitcher in baseball this year?
